source_metadata.title: Ceftazidime/avibactam use for carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae meningitis: a case report

duplicate_review.finding: No exact duplicate atoms retained. Table rows and narrative claims were kept separate only when they represent distinct source assertions.

extraction_limitations: The Drive PDF is a three-page journal-layout file containing adjacent research letters; extraction was bounded to the dkx358 article only.
The case report does not provide patient age, sex, renal function, ceftazidime/avibactam CSF concentrations, organism carbapenemase genotype, or a ceftazidime/avibactam MIC.
Serial Table 1 CSF rows are preserved as row-level atoms because the current LiteratureAtom schema supports only one normalized quantitative result per atom.

Combination MIC ratios (ampicillin/sulbactam and trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole) and disk-diffusion-only susceptibility results are preserved as qualitative results rather than forced into a single numeric estimate.
Bibliographic references were not atomized; cited-study results require direct extraction from those primary sources.
schema_gaps: No dedicated representation exists for a multi-analyte time-series table row.
QuantitativeResult cannot directly encode inequality qualifiers such as > or ≤ separately from the numeric estimate.
QuantitativeResult cannot directly encode paired combination MICs such as >16/8 mg/L or >2/38 mg/L.
